affinity.notes: Fully physical hide, armor, cloth, and weapon presentation with no elemental construction.

anatomy.notes: Massive bovine humanoid structure and weapon grip are clear.

archetype.notes: Frontline tank or bruiser does not communicate the intended arena-transforming sovereign duty.

counterplay.notes: The huge axe, forward weight, and cumbersome build signal slow committed swings and exploitable recovery.

finish.notes: Cohesive armor, hide, and cloth rendering with excellent value separation.

framing.notes: Centered full-body view strongly communicates scale and weight.

identity.notes: Minotaur warlord identifies the Bull Emperor form.

tier.notes: Blind reviewer perceived T4, not exact intended tier T5.
